notes.title: Closed beta - Details inside
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're running a closed beta for a couple of weeks, prior to the game launch. Please drop us an email at - dan@backtobasicsgaming.com
Tell us why you'd like to join the closed beta.

Thank you in advance.
Dan

notes.title: Pre release Steam keys for Journalists
notes.content:
Are you a writer, blogger, YouTuber games journalist?
Get in touch via email and we'll do our best to get you a Steam key.
Whether you're a hobbyist or professional, we'd love to supply you with a Steam key.

Please email us your requests at - Dan@backtobasicsgaming.com

Thanks in advance,
Dan
